citations.quote: Supervisor Matt Dorsey was elected in 2022 against the backdrop of a record-shattering crisis in accidental drug overdose deaths in San Francisco.
It was my own journey in recovery from addiction that moved me to ask — first Mayor London Breed, and then District 6 voters — for a role on the Board of Supervisors.
